;Armed conflict and attacks
*[[2019 Jersey City shooting]]
**The attack on a kosher grocery in [[Jersey City, New Jersey|Jersey City]] is officially labeled an act of [[Domestic terrorism in the United States|domestic terrorism]] and [[antisemitism]]. [https://www.foxnews.com/us/jersey-city-shooting-kosher-market-hate-crime-anti-semitism (Fox News)]
*A [[suicide bomber]] kills seven [[paramilitary]] [[Iraqi Army|soldiers]] and wounds three others near [[Samarra]], [[Iraq]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-security/suicide-bomber-kills-7-iraqi-paramilitary-fighters-military-idUSKBN1YG26C (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Russia]]'s only [[aircraft carrier]], the ''[[Russian aircraft carrier Admiral Kuznetsov|Admiral Kuznetsov]]'', catches fire while docked in [[Murmansk]]. [https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2019/12/russias-only-carrier-damaged-in-shipyard-accident-now-on-fire/ (Ars Technica)]

;International relations
*Former [[President of Bolivia]] [[Evo Morales]] lands in [[Argentina]] after being granted [[right of asylum|asylum]]. [[Foreign Minister of Argentina]] [[Felipe Solá]] says Morales will receive [[refugee]] status. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-argentina-bolivia-morales/bolivias-morales-lands-in-argentina-will-be-granted-refugee-status-idUSKBN1YG1N2 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting]]
**A trial date has been set for September 2021, after families of the victims sue [[Remington Arms|Remington]] for the "company’s reckless marketing of the Bushmaster [[AR-15]]", the gun used by the perpetrator in the rampage. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-court-sandy-hook/sandy-hook-families-to-get-day-in-court-against-gunmaker-idUSKBN1YG0PF (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[The Citizenship (Amendment) Bill, 2019|Indian Citizenship (Amendment) Bill, 2019]]
**As anger over the new citizenship law grows in the [[India]]n states of [[Assam]] and [[Tripura]], the government calls in the [[Indian Army|Army]] to restore peace. [[Prime Minister of India|Prime Minister]] [[Narendra Modi]] appeals for calm. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-50754065 (BBC News)]
*[[2019 United Kingdom general election]]
**Voters in the [[United Kingdom]] go to the polls to elect members to the [[House of Commons of the United Kingdom|House of Commons]] in the [[2019 United Kingdom general election|general election]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/election-2019-50731632 (BBC News)]
**The [[exit poll]] forecasts a [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative]] [[landslide victory]] with major gains in [[Northern England]]. [[Boris Johnson]] was returned as [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] and formed a [[majority government]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2019/dec/12/exit-poll-election-boris-johnson-jeremy-corbyn-labour (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Leader of the Labour Party (UK)|Leader of the Labour Party]] [[Jeremy Corbyn]] announces  he will step down as party leader following the party's defeat in the general election. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/politics/2019/12/12/jeremy-corbyn-labour-party-results-live/ (''The Telegraph'')]
**[[Leader of the Liberal Democrats]] [[Jo Swinson]] loses her seat in [[East Dunbartonshire (UK Parliament constituency)|East Dunbartonshire]] to the [[Scottish National Party]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/dunbartonshire-east-election-result-jo-swinson-lib-dem-snp-scotland-a9244886.html (''The Independent'')]
**The parliamentary leader of the [[Northern Ireland|Northern Irish]] [[Democratic Unionist Party]] (DUP) [[Nigel Dodds]] loses his seat in [[Belfast North (UK Parliament constituency)|Belfast North]] as [[Irish nationalism|Nationalist]] MPs overtake [[Unionism in Ireland|Unionists]] in Northern Ireland for the first time. [https://www.politicshome.com/news/uk/politics/news/108521/dup-deputy-leader-nigel-dodds-loses-his-seat-seismic-night-northern (Politics Home)]
*[[2019 Algerian protests]], [[2019 Algerian presidential election]]
**Thousands of protesters flood the streets of [[Algiers]] to protest the [[President of Algeria|presidential]] election currently underway. As all five candidates have ties to ousted president [[Abdelaziz Bouteflika]], protesters call the election a sham and demand that [[Algerian People's National Armed Forces|the military]] withdraw its influence from political life. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/algerian-protesters-streets-reject-election-191212132225343.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2020 Israeli legislative election]]
**The [[Knesset|Israeli parliament]] votes to dissolve itself and schedules an unprecedented [[2020 Israeli legislative election|third election in a year]] for 2 March 2020. [https://www.jpost.com/Israel-Elections/Third-election-in-a-year-official-as-Knesset-misses-deadline-610620 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[2019 Chilean protests]]
** The [[impeachment]] process against President [[Sebastián Piñera]] is defeated by 79 votes against 73 in the [[Chamber of Deputies of Chile|Chamber of Deputies]]. The impeachment process was initiated after several human rights violations have been reported against protestors. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/chile-pinera-faces-impeachment-bid-crackdown-protests-191212162149314.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Science and technology
*The U.S. [[Federal Communications Commission]] designates 988 as the new phone number of the [[National Suicide Prevention Lifeline]]. [https://nbc25news.com/news/nation-world/fcc-votes-to-set-up-3-digit-suicide-hotline-number-like-911 (Associated Press)]
